name: What is the process for AKN Design Group to install a new bathtub as part of a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for AKN Design Group to install a new bathtub as part of a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group's process for installing a new bathtub within a bathroom remodel begins with integrated design planning, where we collaborate on selecting the ideal tub for your spa-inspired vision. Once the design is finalized and materials are ordered, our construction phase includes careful demolition, necessary plumbing adjustments, structural modifications if required, and the precise installation of the bathtub. This is followed by surrounding tile work, fixture installation, and finishing touches. As your single point of coordination, we oversee every detail, ensuring craftsmanship and clear communication from concept to completion, resulting in a cohesive and luxurious bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process for bathtub installation involves integrated design planning, demolition, plumbing adjustments, precise tub installation, and finishing work, all managed by our design-build team.
